The daily work of etchers and engravers revolves around workpieces and processes: reading drawings, samples, and process cards, preparing and cleaning workpieces, mixing etching chemicals, setting equipment and tool parameters, using hand or machine tools to etch and engrave metal, glass, plastic, and other materials, checking depth, evenness, and appearance, and keeping process records.
